description: Implement a high-fidelity closed-loop patrol controller using Odometry feedback and Proportional Control laws.

oracle_tests.description: Validates initial pose recording and Euclidean distance calculation.
Checks for trigonometric normalization to handle -pi/pi transitions.
Verifies that velocity is a function of error (P-Control) rather than a constant.
Ensures the loop respects rclpy state and safety timeouts.
